pricing_note: No adult membership is published: adult training is sold per class at $20, with adult open-gym at $10. Youth programmes are published as monthly rates — $75 and $140 for preschool once or twice a week, $95 and $170 for the graded levels — but a youth rate cannot anchor an adult listing.
